title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description_text:
YOUR BRILLIANT FUTURE IN TECH IS NOW
Welcome to the world of Zoi! We transform manufacturing and retail enterprises through AI-first strategies that deliver measurable business value. We don't just advise: we implement, operate, and scale solutions that turn AI adoption into competitive advantage,
We are expanding our European teams in Stuttgart, Cologne, Berlin, Lisbon and Spain.
WHAT YOU DO
Architectural Leadership: You design and execute high-stakes data projects with building resilient, enterprise-grade big data platforms from the ground up.
Technical Subject Matter Expertise: As an expert, you engineer bespoke solutions tailored to complex client needs, providing end-to-end technical leadership across the entire project lifecycle.
AI Data Foundations: You don’t just build pipelines; you architect the high-fidelity data backbone that powers the next generation of Agentic AI and Predictive Business Intelligence.
Infrastructure Mastery: You are the definitive authority on Cloud Data Warehousing and Data Lakehouse architectures, ensuring scalability, security, and peak performance.
WHO YOU ARE
Proven Track Record: 7+ years of dedicated Data Engineering experience, demonstrating mastery over complex database systems and high-velocity, high-volume data environments.
Deep Architectural Insight: You possess a profound understanding of data modeling and cloud warehouse design. You comfortably navigate the spectrum from Traditional Analytical Warehouses to Modern Transactional AI Warehouses.
Deep Knowledge on Enterprise Data Landscape - Further, you possess a comprehensive understanding of Data Value Chain, looking beyond the data lake to understand upstream source systems and downstream business applications.
Cloud Native: Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a significant advantage (specifically BigQuery).
Consulting Mindset: Ability to translate high-level business requirements into robust technical specifications.
Strategic Communication: You are an elite communicator, capable of distilling intricate technical architectures into clear, persuasive narratives
Enterprise Integration: Experience navigating SAP environments (e.g., SAP Datasphere, BW/4HANA) or integrating SAP data into modern cloud stacks.
Communication & Language: Excellent written and spoken English is mandatory. If you are based in Germany, C1-Proficiency in German is highly preferred to lead local client engagements and workshops.
Do you like to be surrounded by brilliant minds? Awesome. At Zoi, you become part of our community of tech enthusiasts and develop your full potential. Create fresh ideas and shape the digital transformation of our enterprise customers sustainably.
GOOD WORK SHOULD BE REWARDED, which is why we offer various bonus models at our company
TIME IS WISDOM, 20 % of your working time is available for experimenting and education
SKILL YOURSELF UP, Zoi can only be as good as you are. That’s why we value constant training and development
BE FREE thanks to our absolutely flexible working hours and work remotely from any of our locations
LEVERAGE AI POWER with access to cutting-edge AI technologies, to automate tasks, gain insights, and innovate
DEVELOP YOURSELF with our individual certification and training plan
FAMILY COMES FIRST, rely on our financial support for childcare
REFUEL at our regular free Friday lunch
Zoi is an equal opportunity employer, we're committed to helping you do your best work. Our promise is to champion diversity, build an inclusive culture and do our part to create a more equitable professional landscape.
